validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <script src="lib.wasm">input = 1;</script>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<script>` cannot have both a `src` attribute and inline content
notes: SCXML 1.0 §5.8: `<script>` takes either a `src` URI or inline script content, never both
diagnostics.help: keep the external `src` and delete the inline content, or delete `src` and keep the inline script

fixes.message: remove the `src` attribute and keep the inline script
